{{Top|leg}}
'''H'Kak bushes''' grew on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[H'Kak bean]]s, which had an intense orange color, were harvested from the bushes to make [[Tatooine H'Kak bean tea|H'Kak bean tea]].
